## CI/CD

This project uses GitHub Actions for automatic checks.

When I push new changes to GitHub, the CI workflow runs automatically.

The workflow checks that the job can run successfully.

## How to Contribute

1. Create an Issue to describe a problem or suggest an improvement.
2. Create a new branch.
3. Make changes to the project.
4. Open a Pull Request.
5. Check the CI results.
6. Merge the Pull Request into the main branch.

## What I Learned

I learned how to use GitHub Issues, branches, and Pull Requests.

I also learned how to use GitHub Actions to run simple automatic checks.
